claim.quote: Polarized deep--inelastic scattering data on longitudinally polarized hydrogen and deuterium targets have been used to determine double spin asymmetries of cross sections.

name: HERMES quark helicity distributions for up, down and strange quarks

summary.plain: Using spin asymmetries of identified pions and kaons, HERMES separated the contributions of up, down and strange quarks and antiquarks to the proton's spin, finding no significant strange-quark polarisation.
summary.technical: Inclusive and semi-inclusive double-spin asymmetries for charged pions and kaons from longitudinally polarised hydrogen and deuterium targets, used with a leading-order analysis to extract the helicity distributions of u, d, ubar, dbar and s quarks.

title: Quark helicity distributions in the nucleon for up, down, and strange quarks from semi-inclusive deep-inelastic scattering
why_it_matters: First flavour-separated quark helicity distributions including the strange sea from semi-inclusive deep-inelastic scattering.
